    woman_patches = image_patch.find("woman")
    black_patches = image_patch.find("black")
    
    # Filter patches that contain both woman and black
    woman_black_patches = [patch for patch in woman_patches if patch in black_patches]
    
    # If no patches contain both woman and black, return a message indicating so
    if not woman_black_patches:
        return "There is no woman wearing all black in the image."
    
    # Sort patches by their distance from the top of the image
    woman_black_patches.sort(key=lambda patch: patch.upper)
    
    # Get the patch with the smallest upper bound (i.e., closest to the top of the image)
    closest_patch = woman_black_patches[0]
    
    # Check if the woman in the patch is seeing her back
    is_seeing_back = closest_patch.verify_property("woman", "seeing her back")
    
    return bool_to_yesno(is_seeing_back)
